title: RiskyPy: Toward Model-Calibrated Prompt Generation for Joint Security and Functionality Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.40735v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating approaches that improve the security of LLM code generation requires datasets that jointly assess security and functionality and remain adapted to the capabilities of the models being studied. However, existing benchmarks are costly to produce and are generally not calibrated to a chosen range of model capabilities. We introduce RiskyPy, an automated pipeline that generates security-oriented code-generation datasets calibrated to model proficiency using functionality and vulnerability canaries. We instantiate RiskyPy for Python using domains covering 18 CWEs from the 2025 CWE Top 25, producing 101 prompts. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Seed-Coder-8B show that the generated tasks remain functionally accessible, with 57-72% of prompts yielding functional code, while only 5-10% of generations are free of Bandit findings, leaving room for joint evaluation of security and functionality of security improvement approaches.

translated_title: RiskyPy：面向模型校准的提示生成方法，用于LLM生成代码的安全性与功能性联合评估
translated_abstract: 评估提升LLM代码生成安全性的方法，需要能够同时评估安全性与功能性、并与所研究模型能力相适配的数据集。然而，现有基准的构建成本高昂，且通常无法校准到特定的模型能力范围。我们提出了RiskyPy，这是一个自动化流水线，利用功能性与漏洞金丝雀（canaries）生成与模型能力水平相校准的面向安全的代码生成数据集。我们将RiskyPy应用于Python，涵盖2025年CWE Top 25中的18个CWE领域，生成了101个提示。在Qwen3-4B和Seed-Coder-8B上的实验表明，所生成的任务在功能上仍然可达成，其中57-72%的提示能够生成功能正常的代码，而仅有5-10%的生成结果不存在Bandit安全告警，从而为安全改进方法的安全性与功能性联合评估留下了空间。
tldr: RiskyPy提出了一种自动化流水线，利用功能性与漏洞金丝雀生成与模型能力相校准的安全导向代码生成数据集，实现了对LLM生成代码安全性与功能性的联合评估。
en_tdlr: RiskyPy is an automated pipeline that generates model-calibrated, security-oriented code-generation datasets using functionality and vulnerability canaries, enabling joint security and functionality evaluation of LLM-generated code.
